about: Explicit circuits for the level-3 rows of the unified borrowed-identity search, rebuilt by borrowed_identities/export_unified.py. Cite S. Singh, C. Gidney and C. Jones, "Borrowed Identities: Malleable Distillation Factories and a Unified Numerical Search," arXiv:2606.28518 (2026).
conventions: n counts the input T states and N the circuit wires, as in the upstream tables; wires 0..k-1 are the outputs. A gate [support, c] is the parity rotation by c*pi/8 on its support, c modulo 8; the odd-c gates consume T states and are the columns, and even-c gates are Clifford. d is measured here over the columns, with d_witness an undetectable damaging fault of that weight, and A_d is the number of such faults. A circuit of the other two tables identical to an all_factories.csv one is listed once, under the latter.

circuits.reference: Webster et al. (2023); Gong et al. (2026)
